scientific_limitations_and_integrity.limits: No claim about mass-conserving concentration mixtures, arbitrary transients, nonharmonic storms, noisy inference or physical catchment pathway-count identification.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.literature_priority: Provisional: Evans and Davies (1998) and Hornberger et al. (2001) available as abstracts/metadata rather than complete primary full text; inspected Lloyd et al. (2016) and Outram et al. (2014) are substantively different.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.proof_basis: Analytic polynomial degree bound and rank-surjectivity proof through negative-real interlacing; exact finite arithmetic and quadrature provide reproducible diagnostics only.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.scope: Exact conditional theorem for harmonic common-input, uncoupled positive first-order path mixtures with distinct relaxation times; frequency-domain oriented ellipse area, not field-observed storm shapes.

title: Sharp frequency-reversal capacity of positive parallel catchment pathways
